title: MSFS 2020 Marketplace WARNING: real detail vs. shovelware?
description:
Separating the gems from the junk in the MSFS 2020 Marketplace! Today we look at two very different releases: the long-awaited Carenado B200 King Air and the controversial RCZ Explorer Concept from Dream Scenery.

The Carenado B200 is a legendary twin-turboprop brought to life with incredible HQ textures, realistic wear-and-tear, and multiple mission configurations (including the Air Ambulance/Medevac interior). We test the Collins avionics and the integration with the GTN 750 for the ultimate regional flight experience.

On the flip side, we analyze the RCZ Explorer. While it promises a "new era of personal aviation," we look closer at the red flags—from the lack of cockpit screenshots to the basic "too clean" modeling. Is this innovation, or another "showware" entry you should skip?

In this video:

- Carenado B200 exterior & interior modeling.
- The RCZ Warning: Why you need to be careful with "Futuristic" marketplace entries.

Final Verdict: Which one deserves a spot in your hangar?
